title: Voice Physics banner
description: Voices are loud and clear in the open, quiet and dull behind a wall.

title: Voice Physics
description: Proximity voice chat that sounds like the world around you.

cover.for: An addon for Simple Voice Chat
cover.heading: Voice Physics
cover.text: Voices fade with distance, are muffled by walls, come round corners through doorways and echo in caves.

title: The Distance tab
description: The fade curve with the players you hear, presets and a Listen button.
heading: Voices fade the way you choose
text: A live curve with the players you hear, presets for every kind of server, and a Listen button.

title: The Walls tab
description: How a voice sounds behind glass, leaves, wood, dirt, stone, iron and wool.
heading: Walls muffle, doorways let through
text: Glass, wood, stone and wool each sound different. A whisper is lost behind a wall; a shout carries.

title: The Effects tab
description: Echo, water, rain, wind, Doppler and facing, with what applies around you right now.
heading: Echo, water, rain and wind
text: Caves echo, water dulls, wind blows far voices away, and a voice is quieter behind the speaker's back.

title: The HUD
description: Who is talking, how far, behind a wall or whispering, and how many hear you.
heading: See who is talking
text: How far, from where, behind a wall or whispering, and how many players hear you.

title: The Monitor tab
description: Players nearby: who is talking, how loud you hear them and who will not hear you back.
heading: Know who hears you
text: Everyone nearby, how loud each voice reaches you, and who has their sound off.

title: The Server tab
description: For admins: profile, walls, game rules, megaphone and zones, saved on the server right away.
heading: Run it from the server
text: Profiles, zones, game rules and the megaphone. Walls work even for players without the mod.

title: The change log
description: Every change to the server's settings, filtered by player, with undo.
heading: Every change on record
text: Who changed what and when, one player's changes or everyone's, and undo in one click.

title: Settings locked by the server
description: When a server enforces its profile, the locked controls show a padlock.
heading: Servers can lock settings
text: When a server enforces its profile, locked controls show a padlock, so players know why.
